comments.body:
I wrote a complete, self-contained solution to the mode-$k$ RKHS-constrained CP subproblem (Problem 10) into solution.tex. There was no prior solution.tex in the workspace, so this is a from-scratch full solution addressing every requirement of the problem.

**Summary of what is established (all identities verified numerically against dense references):**

1. **Structure (Lemma 1, column-stacking vec):** $(Z\otimes K)\mathrm{vec}(X)=\mathrm{vec}(KXZ^\top)$ and $(Z\otimes K)^\top\mathrm{vec}(Y)=\mathrm{vec}(KYZ)$.

2. **Compressed matvec (Prop 1):** with $\tilde K\in\mathbb R^{q\times n}$, $\tilde Z\in\mathbb R^{q\times r}$ the observed rows, $F=\tilde K W$, $y=(F\circledast\tilde Z)\mathbf 1_r$, $G=\tilde K^\top\mathrm{diag}(y)\tilde Z$, and $A\,\mathrm{vec}(W)=\mathrm{vec}(G+\lambda KW)$. Cost $O(qnr+n^2r)$ — no object of size $N$ or $M$ ever appears. (verified to machine precision.)

3. **Preconditioner:** full-data normal matrix $P=(Z^\top Z)\otimes K^2+\lambda(I_r\otimes K)$. $Z^\top Z$ via the Hadamard-of-Grams identity $\odot_{i\ne k}A_i^\top A_i$ (no $M$-cost). $P$ factored by two small eigendecompositions ($Z^\top Z=UDU^\top$, $K=VLV^\top$): eigenvalues $p_{a,b}=d_a\ell_b^2+\lambda\ell_b$, $O(n^2r+nr^2)$ solve. (verified.)

4. **Correctness (Thm 1):** PCG operators implement $A$ and $P^{-1}$; standard PCG convergence with $A,P\succ0$ for $\lambda>0,K\succ0$. **Singular-kernel case (Prop 2):** system consistent, $KW$ unique on $\mathcal R=\mathrm{range}(I_r\otimes K)$ where $A\succeq\lambda\sigma_{\min}^+(K)$ (verified); floored pseudo-solve keeps the iteration in $\mathcal R$.

5. **Two algorithm boxes** (direct Cholesky $O(qn^2r^2+n^3r^3)$; PCG $O(qn+n^3+r^3+\kappa(qnr+n^2r+nr^2))$) and full complexity analysis; $\tilde Z$, $B=TZ$ (MTTKRP), and the RHS all formed from the $q$ sparse triples with no $N$- or $M$-cost.

**Numerical evidence:** $n=30,r=6,q=1500,\lambda=10^{-2}$, rank-20 kernel + ridge: $\kappa_2(A)\approx1.3\times10^3$ vs $\kappa_2(P^{-1}A)\approx10$; PCG reached rel. residual $10^{-8}$ in 41 iters, plain CG did not converge in 200.

All five proof commandments addressed; naming collisions and a stray placeholder removed; environment/brace/display-math delimiters checked to balance (no LaTeX toolchain installed to compile). Marking resolved.
